status.beyondsolo.title: TITLE
status.beyondsolo.unevaluated.desc: The System cannot read you yet. Find a village and touch the crystal in its Evaluation Zone.
stat.beyondsolo.str.desc: Strength. More melee damage, harder crits and less knockback.
stat.beyondsolo.agi.desc: Agility. Faster movement and attacks, dodge chance, quicker bow draw, and longer, faster-recharging combat rolls (an extra roll every 25 points).
stat.beyondsolo.vit.desc: Vitality. More max health, natural armor and toughness, better healing, faster fatigue recovery, and resistance to every element and to exhaustion.
stat.beyondsolo.int.desc: Intelligence. More max mana, faster mana regen, shorter cooldowns, and stronger elemental hits (more buildup).
stat.beyondsolo.sense.desc: Sense. Crit chance, luck and reach.
objective.beyondsolo.find_village.desc: You woke up somewhere unknown. Find a village to learn what happened to you.
objective.beyondsolo.find_evaluation_zon: Find the Evaluation Zone in this village and touch the crystal to receive your rank and class.
log.beyondsolo.hint: hides the pop-ups on screen, or brings the latest back
hud.beyondsolo.collapsed.hint: Your body won't move. Sleep or wait it out.
evaluation.beyondsolo.scan.title: EVALUATING
evaluation.beyondsolo.rank.title: %s-Rank
evaluation.beyondsolo.rank.e: Faint mana response. Everyone starts somewhere.
evaluation.beyondsolo.rank.d: Stable mana response. A spark worth feeding.
evaluation.beyondsolo.rank.c: Strong mana response. Solid potential confirmed.
evaluation.beyondsolo.class.warrior: Strength and endurance. First into every fight.
evaluation.beyondsolo.class.assassin: Speed and precision. Strikes before the enemy can react.
evaluation.beyondsolo.class.mage: Vast mana and a sharp mind. Power from a distance.
evaluation.beyondsolo.class.guardian: Unshakable vitality. The shield others stand behind.
evaluation.beyondsolo.class.healer: Deep mana and resilience. Keeps the party alive.
evaluation.beyondsolo.class.ranger: Keen senses and swift feet. Nothing escapes notice.
notify.beyondsolo.welcome.title: Welcome, Player.
notify.beyondsolo.welcome.body: You have been chosen. The System will awaken once you are evaluated.
notify.beyondsolo.scan_interrupted.title: Evaluation interrupted
notify.beyondsolo.scan_interrupted.body: You moved too far from the crystal.
notify.beyondsolo.evaluated.title: Evaluation complete
notify.beyondsolo.system_online.title: The System is now active
notify.beyondsolo.system_online.body: Press [%s] to open your Status window. Press [%s] to hide or bring back these messages.
notify.beyondsolo.level_up.title: Level Up!
notify.beyondsolo.level_up.body: You reached level %s. Unspent stat points: %s
notify.beyondsolo.exhaustion_warning.bod: Rest now, or your body will give out.
notify.beyondsolo.collapse.title: You collapsed
notify.beyondsolo.collapse.body: Your body has reached its limit. You can't move for %s seconds.
notify.beyondsolo.recovered.title: Recovered
item.beyondsolo.quenching_elixir.desc: Puts out a Deep Burn, the only thing that can. Wards against fire for a minute.
item.beyondsolo.antidote.desc: Cures Venom and poison. Too weak for Heavy Venom.
item.beyondsolo.greater_antidote.desc: Cures any venom, Heavy Venom included, and wards against poison.
item.beyondsolo.clotting_tonic.desc: Stops bleeding, lifts a Crimson Brand and wards against blood loss.
tooltip.beyondsolo.armor_weight: Heavy armor: sprinting is more tiring
set.beyondsolo.hunter.bonus: Full set: 20% less exhaustion, a little faster
set.beyondsolo.knight.bonus: Full set: +20% blood resistance, stands firm against knockback
set.beyondsolo.dusk.bonus: Full set: +15% fire, poison and crimson resistance
quest_fail.beyondsolo.day_ended: The day ended before it was done.
quest.beyondsolo.proof_of_strength.desc: The System wants to see what you can do. Defeat the creatures that roam the dark.
quest.beyondsolo.provisions.desc: No hunter survives on luck alone. Gather iron and wood for the road ahead.
quest.beyondsolo.growth.desc: Strength is earned, not given. Grow stronger and cover ground.
quest.beyondsolo.trial_of_depths.desc: Find a gate and go through it. Clear the dungeon on the other side, and cut down whatever crosses your path.
quest.beyondsolo.daily.desc: Train every day without fail. Unfinished training at dawn will be punished.
quest.beyondsolo.spawner_nest.desc: A nest of monsters has been detected. Destroy its spawn and the source before it spreads. Do not leave the area.
quest.beyondsolo.ambush.desc: You are surrounded. Survive and fight back.
quest.beyondsolo.deep_veins.desc: The rock here is thick with ore. Mine it while you can.
quest.beyondsolo.offer.title: New quest: %s
quest.beyondsolo.reward.title: Title: %s
quest.beyondsolo.penalty: Penalty: +%s%% fatigue, weakness and slowness for %ss
command.beyondsolo.quest.none: Nothing to do: no matching quest.
item.beyondsolo.sealed_parcel.hint: Use it at the marked spot to deliver it
npc.beyondsolo.empty: %s has nothing more to ask of you today. New requests come at dawn.
npc.beyondsolo.shunned: %s doesn't trust you after the last request. Come back tomorrow.
npc.beyondsolo.full: You already hold %s requests. Finish one first.
npc.beyondsolo.nest.title: The nest stirs
npc.beyondsolo.nest.body: Monsters crawl out around the marked spot.
npc.beyondsolo.giver_gone.title: %s is gone
npc.beyondsolo.giver_gone.body: No one to report back to. "%s" will complete on its own.
npc.beyondsolo.parcel.void: This parcel's delivery fell through. It crumbles in your hands.
npc.beyondsolo.parcel.not_here: Not here. The marked spot is %s blocks %s.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.gather.0.desc: %s is running short. Bring what is needed and hand it over.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.gather.1.desc: %s wants to be ready before the next hard night. Gather the goods and bring them back.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.gather.2.desc: Work has stopped at %s's bench. Fetch the materials and return.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.hunt.0.desc: %s wants the %s problem near the village dealt with. Defeat them, then report back.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.hunt.1.desc: %2$s sightings keep %1$s up at night. Hunt them down and report back.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.hunt.2.desc: %s posted a bounty on every %s in the area. Collect it once they are dealt with.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.clear.0.desc: %s saw monsters gathering %s blocks %s of here. Clear the nest, then report back.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.clear.1.desc: Something has made a lair %2$s blocks %3$s of the village. %1$s wants it gone.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.clear.2.desc: %s marked a nest %s blocks %s of here. Wipe it out and come back.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.escort.0.desc: %s must reach a spot %s blocks %s of here. Keep them alive on the way.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.escort.1.desc: %s is afraid of the road. Walk with them %s blocks %s and see them there safely.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.escort.2.desc: Guard %s on the road %s blocks %s. If they fall, the request fails.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.deliver.0.desc: %s hands you a sealed parcel. Carry it %s blocks %s and use it at the marked spot.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.deliver.1.desc: %s needs a parcel taken %s blocks %s, and fast. Use it when you get there.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.deliver.2.desc: %s's letter must reach the place %s blocks %s of here. Use the parcel there.
quest_fail.beyondsolo.lost: The one you protected was lost.
quest.beyondsolo.ready.title: Ready to hand in: %s
notify.beyondsolo.gate.detected.title: A %s-Rank Gate Has Been Detected
notify.beyondsolo.gate.detected.body: A rift to the %s. Danger: %s. Step into it to enter.
notify.beyondsolo.gate.danger.title: Warning
notify.beyondsolo.gate.danger.body: This %s-Rank Gate is far above your rank. Survival is not expected.
notify.beyondsolo.gate.opened.title: A %s-Rank Gate Has Opened
notify.beyondsolo.gate.opened.body: Something tore through the world about %s blocks from you.
notify.beyondsolo.gate.exit.title: The Gate Is Closing
notify.beyondsolo.gate.exit.body: An exit has opened in the boss's arena. Leave before the gate closes.
notify.beyondsolo.gate.cache.title: Rewards
message.beyondsolo.gate.unevaluated: The gate rejects you. The System cannot read you yet.
quest.beyondsolo.gate_clear.desc: You have entered the %s. Cut through its monsters and defeat %s, the gate's master.
command.beyondsolo.gate.not_inside: You are not inside a gate.
item.beyondsolo.skill_tome.unread.tip: Read it to learn a skill your class doesn't know yet.
skills.beyondsolo.tome.unreadable: The writing means nothing to you yet. The System has not awakened.
skills.beyondsolo.tome.nothing: There is nothing left in this tome for you to learn.
skills.beyondsolo.tome.wrong_class: Your class can't make sense of this skill.
skills.beyondsolo.tome.mastered: You have already mastered this skill.
skills.beyondsolo.acquired.equip: Equip it in the System window
skills.beyondsolo.acquired.passive: Always active. See it in the System window
skills.beyondsolo.refused.blocked: You can't use skills right now
skills.beyondsolo.bar.hint: Click a slot to assign. Right click clears.
skills.beyondsolo.bar.hint_none: Pick a learned active skill to equip it.
skills.beyondsolo.locked.or_tome: or sooner from a Skill Tome
skill.beyondsolo.surge_step.flavour: Mana floods your legs and the world blurs past.
skill.beyondsolo.surge_step.desc: Dash %s blocks the way you are facing. Breaks falls and shrugs off a hit for a moment.
skill.beyondsolo.pulse_scan.flavour: A ring of mana rolls out and everything hostile lights up.
skill.beyondsolo.pulse_scan.desc: Reveals every hostile creature within %s blocks through walls for %s seconds.
skill.beyondsolo.appraising_gaze.flavour: Look closer. Every creature has a seam.
skill.beyondsolo.appraising_gaze.desc: For %s seconds, see each creature's level, health and elemental weakness, with its weak spot marked. Your hits deal %s%% more.
skill.beyondsolo.phantom_shroud.flavour: Your outline frays into smoke and the monsters lose you.
skill.beyondsolo.phantom_shroud.desc: Hide from monsters for %s seconds. Anything chasing you loses track. Attacking ends it.
skill.beyondsolo.unbroken_will.flavour: The body tires. The will doesn't.
skill.beyondsolo.mana_flow.flavour: Mana runs through you like a second pulse.
skill.beyondsolo.rending_arc.flavour: One swing that cuts the air itself.
skill.beyondsolo.rending_arc.desc: A crescent slash in front of you: %s damage (+STR) to everything in the arc, knocking it back.
skill.beyondsolo.war_cry.flavour: A roar that steadies allies and shakes monsters.
skill.beyondsolo.war_cry.desc: You and nearby allies gain Strength %s for %s seconds. Nearby monsters are weakened and slowed.
skill.beyondsolo.earthsplitter.flavour: Leap, then bring the ground down with you.
skill.beyondsolo.earthsplitter.desc: Leap up and slam down: %s damage (+STR) in a wide ring, throwing monsters into the air.
skill.beyondsolo.shadowstep.flavour: There one moment, behind them the next.
skill.beyondsolo.shadowstep.desc: Blink behind the creature you look at (or ahead). Your next strike within 3 seconds deals %s%% more and crits.
skill.beyondsolo.venom_edge.flavour: Coat the blade. Let it work.
skill.beyondsolo.venom_edge.desc: For %s seconds, your strikes add %s venom buildup.
skill.beyondsolo.keen_instinct.flavour: You move before you decide to.
skill.beyondsolo.veil_of_night.desc: Vanish for %s seconds. Monsters lose you, and your first strike from the dark deals %s%% more.
skill.beyondsolo.arc_bolt.flavour: A thread of lightning, pulled straight from your mana.
skill.beyondsolo.arc_bolt.desc: Hurl a bolt at the creature you look at: %s damage (+INT).
skill.beyondsolo.ember_burst.flavour: Heat gathers in your chest and bursts out.
skill.beyondsolo.ember_burst.desc: A ring of fire around you: %s damage (+INT) and %s burn buildup, pushing monsters back.
skill.beyondsolo.starfall.flavour: Call down burning stars on the place you point to.
skill.beyondsolo.starfall.desc: %s meteors fall where you look, %s damage (+INT) each, with burn buildup.
skill.beyondsolo.bulwark.flavour: Raise a wall of mana around yourself.
skill.beyondsolo.bulwark.desc: Gain a %s point shield and Resistance for 6 seconds.
skill.beyondsolo.provoke.desc: Every monster within %s blocks turns on you and is slowed. You gain Resistance.
skill.beyondsolo.stoneskin.flavour: Blows land on you like rain on rock.
skill.beyondsolo.aegis_dome.flavour: A dome of light that nothing hostile can stand inside.
skill.beyondsolo.aegis_dome.desc: For %s seconds, allies inside the dome gain Resistance II and Regeneration. Monsters are pushed out.
skill.beyondsolo.mending_light.desc: Heal yourself and allies within 7 blocks for %s health.
skill.beyondsolo.purify.flavour: Wash away what clings to you.
skill.beyondsolo.purify.desc: Cleanse you and nearby allies of venom, the crimson brand, buildups and most harmful effects. Heavy venom and deep burns still need their remedies.
skill.beyondsolo.life_bloom.flavour: Life keeps growing back in you.
skill.beyondsolo.sanctuary.flavour: Holy ground: healing for friends, pain for foes.
skill.beyondsolo.sanctuary.desc: For 8 seconds, allies in the circle heal %s per second, and monsters in it are hurt and slowed.
skill.beyondsolo.piercing_shot.flavour: An arrow of mana that does not stop.
skill.beyondsolo.piercing_shot.desc: Fire a shot that pierces everything in a line for %s damage (+AGI).
skill.beyondsolo.hunters_mark.flavour: Pick your prey. Everyone else will too.
skill.beyondsolo.hunters_mark.desc: Mark the creature you look at for 12 seconds. It glows and takes %s%% more damage from everyone.
skill.beyondsolo.arrow_rain.desc: %s arrows rain down where you look.
